rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account dated 16 September 2020 says that on the afternoon of that day both Houses held the designation ballots and 菅義偉 was designated as the 99th Prime Minister counting from Itō Hirobumi.

bounded_scope: Head-of-government observations for CLAUDE-C01-13 only (stacked on CLAUDE-C01-12).
